The Tier-1 “direct” label refers to direct experimental support for the recorded endpoint and includes molecular, cellular, organ-level and physiological functional responses. It is not synonymous with a binary receptor–ligand affinity measurement. Accordingly, XP017 is an in-vivo nonhuman-primate hepatic functional-response axis, XP050 records reduced rather than absent porcine-renin activity toward human/primate angiotensinogen, and XP051 is a porcine vasopressin-physiology response without a direct AVPR2-affinity claim.
